text:
Mika: LAN night this Friday? thinking of doing a chill couch-coop + smash mini bracket. who’s in? :video_game:
Samir: in. can we ditch the dock this time? my switch dock last time fried the TV port :grimacing:
Devon: i'll bring my dock but it’s temperamental. pro tip: bring an HDMI switch so we can hot-swap consoles without unplugging everything.
Asha: yes to HDMI switch. also i can bring a surge-protected power strip and a little label tape so controllers don’t vanish into the void.
Mika: perfect. plan: start at 6pm, snacks at 7, bracket at 8. casual open play until then.
Samir: Q: how many TV screens? last time we had a queue.
Mika: we have 2 big TVs in lounge + projector available if we can get the AV cable from eng-rooms. ops-bot: @Mika AV cable checkout request submitted (ticket #4421). ETA: 2h.
Devon: bringing 2 pro controllers and my dock. if dock acts up, fallback is handheld mode + adapters.
Asha: i’ll bring ethernet switch + 2 extra cat6s. wired > wifi for smash lobbies.
Mika: poll: what should be the bracket prize? 1) sticker pack 2) mystery trophy (tiny) 3) coffee shop voucher
Samir: 2 for the vibes.
Devon: 3, i need caffeine to recover from getting 3-0’d.
Asha: 1 seems cute.
GameNightBot: poll created: React with :one: :two: :three: to vote. Poll closes Fri 5:30pm.
Mika: also anyone need a controller loaner? put your name and preferred platform.
Samir: i might borrow a joycon charger if anyone has one.
Asha: brought extras last time, will add a spare charger to the pile.
Mika: tl;dr — Fri 6pm lounge, 2 TVs + projector, bring controllers/dock/HDMI switch if you can. vote on the prize via poll. cheers :party_parrot:
Devon: excited. bringing gummy bears.
Samir: see y’all Friday :thumbsup:
